native_mapping.fallback: If cursor-unslop is unavailable, report that the full technical-writing workflow is blocked; a partial prose review must be labeled partial.

permission_gates: Apply a native instruction-only writing standard and preserve symbols, wording, intent, and language.
The source requires cursor-unslop on every document touched; do not call a prose-only review complete when it is unavailable.
Respect the current task scope, selected model/effort, repository ownership, and explicit approval requirements.

behavioral_proof.positive: Guide fixture is checked by the proof harness `scripts/cursor_functional_adapters.py:review_prose`; this validates the rule shape, not a native runtime implementation.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: The prose harness can return a partial result, but it does not substitute for required cursor-unslop or prove the complete workflow.
behavioral_proof.error: The harness exercises the invalid/error or unsafe-permission case for `review_prose` and records rejection or preservation; no workflow parity is claimed.

upstream_readme.note: Verified in the pinned upstream clone; the README is referenced for provenance and is not vendored in this skills-only snapshot.

security_review.decision: Keep the source finding and provenance; do not dismiss it because the adapter adds a warning.
